 Rob Usry USA TODAY Nov. 12, 2026, 6:03 a.m. ET Hear this story Turkey and Belgium meet on Thursday for a UEFA Nations League group stage matchup at Gürsel Aksel Stadium.
 Turkey has gotten off to a horrendous start in Group A1, losing its first four matches and scoring only two goals while conceding 11.
 That run of form cost manager Vincenzo Montella his job, with Sergen Yalçın set for his debut in this match after taking over last month.
 Watch Turkey vs. Belgium on Fubo The Red Devils arrive ranked eighth in the world and third in the group with six points. They trail Italy by just one point for second place.
 Belgium shut out Turkey 3-0 in the reverse fixture in October but fell 4-1 at France in its last outing.
 If you are looking for betting advice for the matchup, we've got you covered. Here are the latest odds for the game.
 Turkey vs. Belgium game odds
 Turkey vs. Belgium prediction, pick
 Will the new-coach bump and playing at home be enough to get Turkey on track? Belgium is just too talented across the board and will nick the result here.
 Prediction:  Turkey 1, Belgium 2
 Turkey vs. Belgium channel, start time, streaming
 When:  Thursday, November 12
 Where: Gürsel Aksel Stadium (Izmir, Turkey)
 Time:  12 p.m. ET
 Channel/streaming:  FS1 ( Watch LIVE on Fubo ), ViX ( Watch on Prime Video )
